Vegan Gyros with Tzatziki

I have been making these for years and my whole family loves them. Here is the long story of how I found the spice mix on holiday in Greece.

Share Facebook Pinterest

Vegan Gyros

Print RecipePin Recipe
Prep Time: 20 mins Cook Time: 30 mins
Servings: 4

Ingredients

  • 400 g oyster mushrooms
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika

Instructions

  1. Tear the mushrooms and fry for 10 minutes.
  2. Mix the tzatziki.
Notes: keeps 3 days.
